title: Prices follow the customer's locale
why: Unit covers the currency lookup and the USD fallback; integration shows the rendered prices for a supported locale, an unsupported one and an unavailable rate service.

title: The customer can override the displayed currency

TC-006.given: a customer who switched the displayed currency to GBP
TC-006.then: the payment gateway receives the amount in USD.

why: Unit covers the override state; integration shows it surviving the checkout steps and the gateway amount staying in USD.

title: The conversion disclaimer is shown
why: Integration shows the disclaimer on the confirmation page and in the email receipt; the legal copy itself is a manual review.

title: Conversions are audited
why: Unit covers the audit event payload; integration shows an event emitted on page load and again on a manual override.
